name: rspd-elaboration-tree
question: What is the elaboration state of each delegated node in the decomposition tree (charter / elaborated / in_progress / done / missing)?
cost_provenance: estimated 2026-06-22 on the ULDF framework repo under Git Bash (win32; slowest supported environment); pessimistic-honest per ORACLE-COST-01. Derive cost scales with the number of delegated sub-spec stores, not total spec size.

schema.tree: array<{id:string, domain:string, status:string, store:string, store_exists:boolean, elaboration:string}>

fallback: Read docs/specs/SPECIFICATION.md and any nested docs/specs/<domain>/SPECIFICATION.md stores; for each requirement row with status [CHARTER]/[ELABORATED]/[IN_PROGRESS]/[DONE] and a 'Spec-Owner: child (delegated)' pointer, check whether the pointed-at <domain>/SPECIFICATION.md store exists (absent => missing/broke; present => map status to elaboration).
